tools.name: render_listing_detail

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_listing_details, get_owner_listing_checklist, search_guides, search_agents, check_landed_purchase_eligibility, quote_service_booking · Private data: fetch, search_listings, get_listing_details, compare_listings, render_listing_detail, search_guides, search_agents, check_landed_purchase_eligibility, search_services, prepare_guest_service_checkout, get_guest_service_checkout_status · Public sink: search_guides, search_agents, search_services, quote_service_booking, prepare_guest_service_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_listing_details, get_owner_listing_checklist, search_guides, search_agents, check_landed_purchase_eligibility, quote_service_booking · Private data: fetch, search_listings, get_listing_details, compare_listings, render_listing_detail, search_guides, search_agents, check_landed_purchase_eligibility, search_services, prepare_guest_service_checkout, get_guest_service_checkout_status · Public sink: search_guides, search_agents, search_services, quote_service_booking, prepare_guest_service_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_listing_details" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
